welcome.label: Guided tour
welcome.search.title: Welcome to Dilchap!
welcome.search.text: Look for an item, a brand or a service near you, then narrow down by city and price.
welcome.sell.title: Sell in minutes
welcome.sell.text: A few photos, a price and your city are all it takes to post a listing.
welcome.messages.title: Chat, meet up, pay
welcome.messages.text: Negotiate in the chat, set the meet-up and pay hand to hand at the hand-over. Replay this tour any time: “Guided tour” in Help.
helpCenter.label: The Help centre
helpCenter.search.title: Ask your question
helpCenter.search.text: Type a few words: the guides about it show up straight away.
helpCenter.sections.title: Step-by-step guides
helpCenter.sections.text: Each guide walks you through the steps with screenshots, on computer and on phone.
helpCenter.contact.title: Still stuck?
helpCenter.contact.text: Write to the Dilchap team: follow their reply in Help & support.
countryPicker.label: Choose your country
countryPicker.country.title: Change country
countryPicker.country.text: Tap here to choose a country and a city: listings, prices and payment methods adapt.
boost.label: Boost a listing
boost.credits.title: Your credits
boost.credits.text: Boosts are paid in credits, bought with Mobile Money in your wallet.
boost.listing.title: Choose the listing
boost.listing.text: Each card shows its visibility and its buttons: Boost, Bump, Stats.
boost.packs.title: Choose the package
boost.packs.text: The packages side by side: what they do, how long they last, their price in credits and in CFA F.
